claims.reason: The two proofs share the same skeleton: unfold `ambientDirectSumEquiv`, apply `trans_symm` twice, apply `lof_eq_of` and `directSum_symm_lof_tmul`, then prove the `haux` identity. That identity is `(auxEquiv ..).symm (lof ⊗ₜ lof) = x ᵍ⊗ₜ y`, proved by `symm_apply_eq`, `auxEquiv_tmul` and `decompose_coe/lof_eq_of`. About 17 lines are duplicated. They differ only in the final Mathlib lemma. `prodEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul_ιMulti` is the special case of `prodEquivTensor_symm_tmul` with a = ιMulti p and b = ιMulti q. The conversion between the two forms (`exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe`, `ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti`, `ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti`) already appears in `coe_prodEquivDirectSum_symm_of_tmul_ιMulti`, so it is written twice as well. There is no dependency problem: the primed lemma needs no hypotheses beyond the file's variables, and `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_mem` uses the ιMulti form, which can be derived after the primed lemma. The ordering is easy to arrange. The refactor is modest but real, because the `rw`-heavy `haux` argument would live in one place.
claims.shared_lemma: Keep `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_tmul'` as the single base lemma, with its existing statement and proof (one `haux` block): `(ambientDirectSumEquiv R P Q).symm (DirectSum.of (Bidegree R P Q) (i, j) (a ⊗ₜ[R] b)) = ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R P Q) a.1 * ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inr R P Q) b.1`. Add a small helper for the ιMulti conversion: `ExteriorAlgebra.map (inl R P Q) (ιMulti R i p : ExteriorAlgebra R P) * ExteriorAlgebra.map (inr R P Q) (ιMulti R j q : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) = ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (i + j) (Fin.append (inl ∘ p) (inr ∘ q))`. Proof: `simp only [exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti]; exact ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti _ _`.
